name: Today's Sales
query:
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'FMDay') AS "Today",
    COUNT(b."name") AS "Total Invoices",
    ROUND(SUM(b."net_total"), 2) AS "Item Total",
    ROUND(SUM(b."total_taxes_and_charges"), 2) AS "Total Taxes and Charges",
    ROUND(SUM(b."grand_total"), 2) AS "Grand Total",
    ROUND(SUM(b."grand_total" - b."rounded_total"), 2) AS "Round Off",
    ROUND(SUM(b."rounded_total" - b."paid_amount" + b."change_amount"), 2) AS "Cash Discounts"
FROM "tabPOS Invoice" b
LEFT JOIN "tabURY Report Settings" rs ON (rs."branch" = %(branch)s)
WHERE b."branch" = %(branch)s
  AND b."docstatus" = 1
  AND b."status" IN ('Consolidated', 'Paid')
  AND (
    ((rs."hours" IS NULL OR rs."hours" = 0) AND b."posting_date" = CURRENT_DATE)
    OR (
      rs."hours" > 0
      AND (b."posting_date" + b."posting_time") >=
        (CURRENT_DATE + make_interval(hours => rs."hours"::integer))
      AND (b."posting_date" + b."posting_time") <
        (CURRENT_DATE + interval '1 day' + make_interval(hours => rs."hours"::integer))
    )
    OR (rs."branch" IS NULL AND b."posting_date" = CURRENT_DATE)
  )
